info.title: Upload Product File
info.description:
Upload non-image files, such as PDF or video to TikTok Shop.
Use this API when you need to add videos to your product to improve the shopping experience, or submit certifications or reports to meet TikTok Shop requirements for listing restricted products.
**Note**: You must store the response body to retrieve the ID or URL required to associate the file with a product during product creation or editing.

post.description:
Upload non-image files, such as PDF or video to TikTok Shop.
Use this API when you need to add videos to your product to improve the shopping experience, or submit certifications or reports to meet TikTok Shop requirements for listing restricted products.
**Note**: You must store the response body to retrieve the ID or URL required to associate the file with a product during product creation or editing.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

data.description:
The local file to be uploaded.

**Note**：
- Supported formats: PDF, MP4, MOV, MKV, WMV, WEBM, AVI, 3GP, FLV, MPEG
- Max PDF size: 20 MB
- Max video size: 100 MB
- Video aspect ratio: 9:16 to 16:9

**Recommendations for product videos**:
- Aspect ratio: 1:1 
- Resolution: HD 720p or higher
- Duration: 20 - 60 seconds

name.description:
The name of the file, including the file extension (e.g. `certification.pdf`)

**Note**:
- Do not use additional periods, except the one preceding the file extension.
- Do not begin the name with symbols.
- Do not include spaces.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

id.description:
The file ID generated by TikTok Shop.
Pass this value when creating or editing a product to associate the file with the product.

url.description: The URL to access and view the file.

format.description:
The format of the file.
Possible values: PDF, MP4, MOV, MKV, WMV, WEBM, AVI, 3GP, FLV, MPEG
